verdict.rationale: Godot documents an official CLI for command-line work and headless operation is explicitly confirmed via runtime probe (`godot --headless` for CI builds, exports, and scripted editor automation), plus EditorScript for scripted automation and one-click exports supporting CI pipelines. Missing for 10: no first-party CI/CD documentation or GitHub Actions template explicitly walking through a CI setup, and no independent hands-on report confirming headless CI use in the wild.
